hero.subtitle2: Ngokungafaniyo le-AI ejwayelekileyo, i-Onesa iyakwisisa ukuphila lebhizinisi eZimbabwe.

tech.objective_subtitle: Ukusebenzisa i-Artificial Intelligence (AI) lezinye indlela zedijithali ukuxhumanisa iZimbabwe labantu bayo abasuka kwamanye amazwe, ngenjongo yokukhuthaza ukubambisana, intuthuko eqhubekayo, lokukhula komnotho kwesikhathi eside.
tech.onesa_desc1: I-Onesa AI luphawu lwethu olwakhelwe ukukhanyisa indlela yokuthi ungaphila kanjani, utshale imali njalo uphumelele eZimbabwe. Lapho amanye amamodeli e-AI ejwayelekileyo esilela kulwazi lwendawo, i-Onesa yakhiwe kusukela phansi ukuze izwisise isimo seZimbabwe ukwedlula noma iyiphi enye.
tech.onesa_desc2: Kusukela ekulandeleni imithetho yendawo kusiya ekuhleleni amabhizinisi axazulula izinkinga ezithile zeZimbabwe, i-Onesa ikunika ulwazi lendawo oludingayo ukuze uphumelele.
tech.onesa_local_edge_desc: Amamodeli ajwayelekileyo ajwayele ukugxila eNtshonalanga, ephumelela eminnothweni ehlelekileyo kodwa ehluleka ukuhambisana lomnotho we-"kukiya-kiya" weMbare Musika kumbe ukujula kolimi lwesigodi sasekhaya.
tech.diaspora_unlocked_desc: Sisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe besimanje ukunika lula ezokuvakasha, ezohwebo, lokutshala imali. Ipulatifomu yethu ivala igebe phakathi kwama-diaspora lamathuba asekhaya ngokusebenzisa obala kwedijithali.
tech.ai_demo_question: Yimaphi amathuba okutshala imali e-agriculture athola inzuzo enengi eZimbabwe njengamanje?
tech.ai_demo_response: Ingxenye ye-agriculture eZimbabwe njengamanje ibona ukukhula okukhulu ekuthunyelweni kwemikhiqizo ye-horticulture. Ngokusekelwe kulokho okwenzakalayo njengamanje, ukutshala imali ekuhlelweni kwezinto zokuthutha ezibandayo (cold-chain logistics) kumatshungwa (blueberries) asuka e-Eastern Highlands kunika inzuzo enkulu...
tech.features_subtitle: Izisetshenziswa ezikhethekileyo ezakhelwe ukuxhumanisa ama-diaspora lamathuba asekhaya.
tech.cta_desc: Hlanganyela lathi ohlelweni lwethu lwe-beta ukuze ube ngowokuqala ukuzibonela ubuhlakani be-Onesa AI.

hero.subtitle1: Kusukela eVictoria Falls kusiya eGreat Zimbabwe, zibonele inhliziyo ye-Africa.
hero.subtitle2: Hlola impucuko yasendulo lamasiko esimanje aphilayo.
hero.subtitle3: Ukuhlangana okungenakulibaleka eziqiwini zelizwe ezinhle kakhulu.

vicfalls.name: Victoria Falls
vicfalls.desc: Enye yezimangaliso eziyisikhombisa zemvelo emhlabeni, impophoma enkulu kakhulu emhlabeni.
vicfalls.summary: Eyaziwa kakhulu ngokuthi yi-Mosi-oa-Tunya (Intuthu Edumayo), iVictoria Falls iyiphinda kabili ukuphakama kwe-Niagara Falls. Thola ithuba lokugibela izikepe, ukugxuma ngetambo (bungee jumping), lokubuka impophoma ngendizamtshina.

greatzim.name: Great Zimbabwe
greatzim.desc: Izinsalela zamatshe zasendulo ezibonisa impucuko yase-Africa yasendulo lobuchwepheshe bokwakha.
greatzim.summary: Yakhwa phakathi kwekhulu le-11 le-15, iGreat Zimbabwe yayiyimfunda-nkulu yombuso weZimbabwe. Izakhiwo zamatshe ezinkulu zakhiwa ngaphandle kokusebenzisa usimende (mortar).

kariba.name: Kariba Dam
kariba.desc: Enye yamachibi amakhulu kakhulu emhlabeni akhiwe ngabantu, alungele ukuhamba ngezikepe-zindlu lokudoba.
kariba.summary: Ichibi laseKariba lidonsa amakhilomitha angaphezu kuka-5,500 square kilometers eduze komfula uZambezi. Laziwa kakhulu ngokudoba i-tiger fish, amaholide ezikepe-zindlu, lokubuka ilanga lishona.

rocks.name: Amatshe agidliselene (Balancing Rocks)
rocks.desc: Amatshe emvelo aveleleyo afanekisela amagugu eZimbabwe ayingqayizivele.
rocks.summary: Lawa matshe anqoba amandla okudonsela phansi avela emalini yeZimbabwe njalo atholakala elizweni lonke, ikakhulu eMatobo National Park.

tourism.other_attractions_subtitle: Ngaphandle kwezindawo eziveleleyo, iZimbabwe inezinhlobonhlobo zezindawo lezinyamazana elizweni lonke.

hwange.name: Hwange National Park
hwange.desc: Isiqiwu esikhulu kunazo zonke eZimbabwe, esaziwa ngemihlambi yendlovu emikhulu.
hwange.summary: Ihlanganisa indawo engaphezu kuka-14,000 square kilometers, iHwange yindawo yokuqala ye-safari. Inemihlobo yezilwane ezincancisayo engaphezu kuka-100 lemihlobo yenyoni engu-400.

matobo.name: Matobo National Park
matobo.desc: Indawo ye-UNESCO World Heritage eyaziwa ngamatshe ayo agidliselene lomlando wokomoya.
matobo.summary: IMatobo Hills inezindawo ezingavamileyo zamatshe e-granite. Yindawo eqakathekileyo ye-archaeological enemifanekiso yama-San eminingi kakhulu e-Southern Africa.

eastern_highlands.name: Eastern Highlands
eastern_highlands.desc: Indawo eqandayo lezintaba eneziganga ezinhle, izimpophoma, leziqongo ezisibekelwe yinkungu.
eastern_highlands.summary: Idonsa emngceleni weMozambique, le ndawo ihlanganisa izintaba zeNyanga, Vumba, leChimanimani.

mana_pools.name: Mana Pools National Park
mana_pools.desc: Indawo ye-UNESCO ekude eyaziwa ngamachibi ayo ondliwa ngumfula le-safari yokuhamba ngezinyawo.
mana_pools.summary: Itholakala e-Zambezi Valley, iMana Pools yaziwa ngobuhle bayo obumangalisayo lamachibi amane amakhulu akhiwa ngumfula.

nyanga.name: Nyanga National Park
nyanga.desc: I-'Little Scotland' yase-Africa, ikhaya lesiqongo esiphakeme kunazo zonke eZimbabwe nempophoma ejule kunazo zonke.
nyanga.summary: INyanga lipharadesi le-highland eliqoqa iMount Nyangani leMutarazi Falls (impophoma yesibili ngokuphakama e-Africa).

gonarezhou.name: Gonarezhou National Park
gonarezhou.desc: I-'Indawo yezindlovu,' ebonakala ngamawa abomvu e-Chilojo Cliffs.
gonarezhou.summary: Njengesiqiwu sesibili ngobukhulu eZimbabwe, iGonarezhou yaziwa ngezindawo zayo ezinamagagasi lamawa amatshe abomvu (sandstone cliffs).

onesa.name: Onesa AI
onesa.title: Isikhokhelo sakho sakhona ephosheni yakho
onesa.subtitle: Ukuhamba eZimbabwe kungaba nzima. I-Onesa AI iyasizwisisa isimo se-"kukiya-kiya" lolwazi lwendawo ukuze uhambo lwakho lube lula.
onesa.companion_title: Kusukela ekubhadaleni indizamtshina, isimo sezulu kumbe ukuthola izindawo ezinhle zasendaweni, i-Onesa AI ikusizile
onesa.companion_subtitle: I-Onesa AI ikusiza ukuhlela uhambo lwakho lokuhamba lapha phakathi. Kusukela ekuzwiseni ukuziphatha kwendawo kusiya ekutholeni izindawo ezinhle ezifihlakeleyo.
onesa.prompt_question: "Onesa, kuyiphi indawo engcono yokudla Isitshwala (Sadza) eHarare namuhla ebusuku?"
onesa.prompt_response: Ukuze uthole isitshwala sangempela eHarare, yana eMbare Musika. Abathengisi bakhona baphakela isitshwala esimnandi esisanda kuphekwa lezitshebo ezitshiyeneyo. Kudume kakhulu ebantwini bakhona. Cela nje 'Isitshwala lenyama' ukuze uthole ukudla okusuthisayo!

hero.subtitle1: Izibonelo zangempela zendlela ama-diaspora aseZimbabwe enza ngayo umahluko obonakalayo.
hero.subtitle2: Ukubonisa amabhizinisi amakhulu aqhutshwa lulwazi lokutshala imali kwama-diaspora.
hero.subtitle3: Ukugqamisa imizamo eletha amasiko aseZimbabwe emhlabeni jikelele.
hero.subtitle4: Izindaba zokulondoloza imvelo lokuphakamisa imiphakathi yezigabeni.
hero.subtitle5: Indlela imali yama-diaspora eguqula ngayo izingxenye zomnotho eziqakathekileyo.

success.objective_subtitle: Ukubonisa umphumela obonakalayo wokuzibandakanya kwama-diaspora eZimbabwe.

leather_goods.title: Impumelelo yokuthunyelwa kwempahla yesikhumba
leather_goods.story: Iqembu labachwepheshe baseZimbabwe abahlala e-Germany baxhumanise abakhiqizi besikhumba basekhaya labathengisi baseYurophu.
leather_goods.testimonial: Ipulatifomu ye-ZIGD isixhumanise lama-diaspora azwisisa ubuciko bethu lezidingo zemakethe yaseYurophu.
leather_goods.author: Tendai Moyo

horticulture_breakthrough.title: Ukuphumelela kwe-Organic Horticulture
horticulture_breakthrough.story: Inhlanganiso yabalimi abancane ithole isitifiketi se-EU organic ngokusekelwa ngama-agronomists angama-diaspora.
horticulture_breakthrough.testimonial: Sasingakaze sicabange ukuthi ipula lethu elincane lingafinyelela amazinga aseYurophu.
horticulture_breakthrough.author: Grace Ncube

tourism_lodge.title: Ukutshala imali ku-Tourism Lodge
tourism_lodge.story: Ngepulatifomu ye-crowdfunding ye-ZIGD, abatshali mali abangama-diaspora abangu-280 bahlanganise u-$500K ukwakha i-eco-lodge eduze laseVictoria Falls.
tourism_lodge.testimonial: Ngaletshala u-$2,000 ngivela e-UK njalo manje sengiyingxenye yabanikazi be-lodge enhle ekhaya.
tourism_lodge.author: Simba Chikwanha

stone_sculpture.title: Inethiwekhi yokuthumela izithombe zamatshe
stone_sculpture.story: Ababazi baseZimbabwe bathole ithuba lokungena ezimakethe zobuciko zase-North America ngezithombe zamatshe.
stone_sculpture.testimonial: Izithombe zethu manje sezikhonjiswa ezigalari emazweni amaningi.
stone_sculpture.author: Patrick Mavros

tech_startup.title: Ukuxhaswa kwe-Tech Startup ngama-Diaspora
tech_startup.story: Inkampani ye-fintech eseHarare ihlanganise u-$750K kubatshali mali abangama-diaspora.
tech_startup.testimonial: Uxhaso lwama-diaspora lweze lolunye ulwazi—sathola abacebisi abazwisisa amazinga we-Silicon Valley lesimo sase-Africa.
tech_startup.author: Tafadzwa Chidavaenzi

honey_export.title: Inhlanganiso yokuthumela inyosi
honey_export.story: Abalimi benyosi ezindaweni zasemaphandleni babumbe inhlanganiso yokuthumela inyosi e-organic eYurophu.
honey_export.testimonial: Kusukela ekuthengiseni inyosi eceleni komgwaqo kusiya ekuthumeleni eYurophu—inethiwekhi yama-diaspora yenze lokhu kwenzeka.
honey_export.author: Rudo Makoni

heritage_tourism.title: Impumelelo ye-Heritage Tourism Package
heritage_tourism.story: Umhlinzeki wezokuvakasha usungule amaphakheji akhethekileyo wama-diaspora abuyela ekhaya.
heritage_tourism.testimonial: Siveze amathuba anceda ama-diaspora ukuxhumana lezimpande zawo bebesekela imiphakathi yakhona.
heritage_tourism.author: Chipo Mutasa

macadamia_nut.title: Indawo yokucubungula ama-Macadamia Nut
macadamia_nut.story: I-Crowdfunding yama-diaspora yenze kwaba lula ukwakhiwa kwendawo yokuqala eZimbabwe yokucubungula amantongomane e-macadamia.
macadamia_nut.testimonial: Sahlanganisa u-$1.2M kubatshali mali abangama-diaspora abakholelwa ekwenzeni inani elengeziweyo (value-addition).
macadamia_nut.author: Ngoni Sibanda
